topics.title: 一般现在时 vs 现在完成时
topics.why: Task 1 描述图表规律、Task 2 陈述普遍现象用一般现在时；谈「到目前为止的影响/经历」用现在完成时。混用是写作最常见的时态失分点。

points.t: 普遍事实 → 一般现在时
points.d: 图表结论、社会现象、客观规律都用一般现在时。
points.ex: The number of students who study abroad increases every year.

points.t: 过去某点到现在的变化 → 现在完成时
points.d: since / over the past decade / so far / to date 触发。
points.ex: Over the past decade, remote work has become the norm in many industries.

points.t: 具体过去时间 → 一般过去时
points.d: in 2020 / last year 出现就用过去时，别画蛇添足加 have。
points.ex: In 2023, the figure peaked at 4.5 million.

mistakes.wrong: The number of visitors has increased in 2019.
mistakes.right: The number of visitors increased in 2019.
mistakes.why: 有具体过去年份就不能用现在完成时。

mistakes.wrong: More and more people have chosen to live alone nowadays.
mistakes.right: More and more people choose to live alone nowadays.
mistakes.why: nowadays 表示持续现状，用一般现在时。

topics.title: 被动语态（Task 1 流程图必会）
topics.why: 流程图（process diagram）里几乎每个动作都是被动：材料「被」加工。不会被动语态，流程图基本写不了。

points.d: 流程图一般现在时被动；历史过程用过去时被动 was collected。
points.ex: The cocoa beans are harvested, dried and then roasted.

points.d: can/must/should be done。
points.ex: The mixture must be heated to 80°C before it can be packaged.

points.d: once / after / until + 被动从句，把两步连成一句，是流程图的加分句式。
points.ex: Once the beans have been ground, they are mixed with milk and sugar.

mistakes.wrong: The beans roast at a high temperature.
mistakes.right: The beans are roasted at a high temperature.
mistakes.why: 豆子是被烤的，必须用被动。

mistakes.wrong: After grinding the beans, they are mixed with milk.
mistakes.right: After being ground, the beans are mixed with milk.
mistakes.why: 原句的 grinding 的主语变成了 they（beans），语义不通。

topics.title: 比较结构
topics.why: Task 1 的核心任务就是「比」：谁多谁少、变化幅度。比较级写错直接影响任务回应分。

points.d: twice as many ... as / three times more than / slightly / marginally / significantly higher than。
points.ex: Sales of electric cars were three times higher in 2023 than in 2018.

points.d: 极值表达是 Task 1 的必写点，注意加 the。
points.ex: France had the largest proportion of elderly citizens.

points.d: while / whereas 连接两个相反趋势，一句话完成对比。
points.ex: Cinema attendance declined steadily, whereas streaming subscriptions rose sharply.

mistakes.wrong: The sales of A is more than B.
mistakes.right: The sales of A are higher than those of B.
mistakes.why: sales 复数；比较对象要对等（those of）。
比较级不能叠加，程度用 much/far 修饰。

topics.title: 定语从句
topics.why: 雅思阅读长难句一半靠定语从句撑着；写作里用 which/who 挂从句能自然拉长句子且不生硬。

points.t: which 指物 / who 指人
points.d: 先行词是人用 who，物用 which，都可以用 that。
points.ex: Students who borrow heavily may struggle financially after graduation.

points.t: 非限制性 which（指代整句）
points.d: 逗号 + which 指前面整句话，写作非常好用的延展句手段。
points.ex: Many graduates take unpaid internships, which often leads to financial stress.

points.d: 正式书面语的加分结构。
points.ex: The framework on which the policy is built remains unclear.

mistakes.wrong: The book which I bought it is useful.
mistakes.right: The book which I bought is useful.
mistakes.why: which 已经是 bought 的宾语，不能再加 it。

topics.title: 让步与转折（议论的骨架）
topics.why: Task 2 论证 = 承认对方观点 + 转折回自己立场。让步状语从句是论证段的标志性句式。

points.d: 放在段首承认对方合理性，主句转回立场。
points.ex: While banning cars may reduce emissions, it could also hurt local businesses.

points.d: 副词版的让步，比 although 更书面。
points.ex: Admittedly, online education lacks face-to-face interaction.

points.t: Despite / In spite of + 名词
points.d: 后接名词或动名词，不接从句。
points.ex: Despite its convenience, fast food poses serious health risks.

mistakes.wrong: Although the cost is high, but many people still buy it.
mistakes.right: Although the cost is high, many people still buy it.
mistakes.why: although 和 but 只能用一个，中式英语典型错误。

mistakes.wrong: Despite of the rain, the event went ahead.

topics.title: 非谓语动词
topics.why: 作文想上 7 分必须展示句法多样性：to do 表目的、-ing 表伴随/结果、-ed 表被动修饰，用对一处是一个加分点。

points.d: 句首或句尾都行，比 in order to 更简洁。
points.ex: To cut emissions, governments should subsidise public transport.

points.d: 主句 + , -ing...，把两个动作压进一句。
points.ex: The city expanded rapidly, swallowing much of the surrounding farmland.

points.d: 被动含义的精简表达，替代一个定语从句。
points.ex: Children raised in bilingual households often show stronger metalinguistic awareness.

mistakes.wrong: Comparing with last year, the figure rose.
mistakes.right: Compared with last year, the figure rose.
mistakes.why: the figure 是被比较的，用 compared。

mistakes.wrong: Hanging on the wall, I saw a picture.
mistakes.right: On the wall hung a picture.
mistakes.why: 分词的逻辑主语必须跟主句主语一致（dangling modifier）。

topics.title: 虚拟语气（建议类报告句）
topics.why: Task 2 提建议的高分句式：If ... were ..., ... would ...。报告/建议信里必备。

points.t: If + 过去式, would + 动词原形
points.d: 对现在的假设，were 用于所有人称。
points.ex: If the government were to subsidise childcare, more women would return to work.

points.d: 建议类万能句式，should 可省略。
points.ex: It is essential that every candidate (should) check the word limit before submitting.

points.t: were it not for / were ... to do 倒装
points.d: 书面正式的虚拟倒装，7 分写作的亮点句。
points.ex: Were it not for state funding, most basic research would grind to a halt.

mistakes.wrong: If I was a policymaker, I will ban single-use plastic.
mistakes.right: If I were a policymaker, I would ban single-use plastic.
mistakes.why: 虚拟条件句用 were + would，不用 was + will。

topics.title: 主谓一致与冠词
topics.why: 语法准确性是四项评分之一。a/an/the 用错和主谓不一致是考官最容易数出来的「低级错误」。

points.t: 第三人称单数 / 复数主语
points.d: the number of + 复数名词 → 单数；a number of + 复数名词 → 复数。
points.ex: The number of applicants has doubled. / A number of problems have emerged.

points.d: 第一次提到用 a/an，再次提到用 the；泛指复数可不加冠词。
points.ex: A city needs an efficient transport system; the system must be affordable.

points.d: information / advice / research / evidence / equipment 不可数，别加 s。
points.ex: Recent research suggests that sleep deprivation impairs memory.

mistakes.wrong: The government have invested in infrastructures.
mistakes.right: The government has invested in infrastructure.
mistakes.why: 英式写作里 government 作单数；infrastructure 不可数。

mistakes.wrong: Children is easily influenced by advertisements.
mistakes.right: Children are easily influenced by advertisements.

topics.title: 倒装与强调（7 分亮点句）
topics.why: 评分标准「语法多样性与准确性」的高分段需要复杂结构准确使用。倒装是最安全的一个。

points.d: Not only / Never / Only in this way + 助动词 + 主语。
points.ex: Not only does exercise improve physical health, but it also boosts mood.

points.d: Only when / Only by + doing 放句首倒装。
points.ex: Only by integrating technology into classrooms can we personalise learning.

points.d: 强调程度的书面变体。
points.ex: So severe was the drought that crops failed across the region.

mistakes.wrong: Not only students benefit from smaller classes.
mistakes.right: Not only do students benefit from smaller classes.
mistakes.why: Not only 前置必须倒装（助动词提前）。

topics.title: 图表写作介词速查
topics.why: Task 1 一半的句子在描述数据，介词用错是纯丢分：in/at/from/to/by 各有分工。

points.d: in 2020 / in May / in the 1990s。
points.ex: In 2010, sales stood at 2 million units.

points.d: at 45% / at its peak / stood at。
points.ex: The unemployment rate remained at 5.2% for three years.

points.d: rose from 20% to 35%；increased by 15 个百分点。
points.ex: The share rose from 20% to 35%, an increase of 15 percentage points.

mistakes.why: 没有 in meanwhile 这个搭配。
